fields.title: 📖 The Qurʾān is the speech of Allah
fields.body:
🖋️ **Aḥmad ibn Ḥanbal** said:

> ***“The Qurʾān is the speech of Allah and is not created.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** **Ahlus-Sunnah** affirm the **Qurʾān** as the ***kalām of Allah***. In this lies the refutation of the **Jahmiyyah**, who sought to nullify Allah’s speech by the claim that the Qurʾān is created.

immutable.source: 📝 al-Lālakāʾī, Sharḥ Uṣūl Iʿtiqād Ahl as-Sunnah wa’l-Jamāʿah, Bāb: Iʿtiqād Aḥmad ibn Ḥanbal, Athar Nr. 317, Band 1, S. 176–177.
